newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock offers 93 more Parc Royale flats.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock offers 93 more Parc Royale flats.

text.p: Wheelock Properties Ltd, unit of Wheelock and Co Ltd, said on Wednesday it released the remaining 83 units at its luxury Parc Royale development in Shatin, bringing the total on sale to 193 this Saturday.

The latest batch of units ranging from 975 to 1,603 square feet was priced 4.9 percent higher than the second batch of 50 units offered on January 21, at about HK$6458 per square foot, the Hong Kong company said in a statement.
Of the 193 units for the upcoming sale, 64 units are sized 1,603 square feet, 69 units measure 1,200 square feet and the remaining 60 units range at about 1,000 square feet, it said.
